entries.zh: 我们推荐购买$OVERLORD_TITLE$，因为它开启了全新的蜂巢思维特有起源，其特殊的子嗣领袖可以用来增强您的帝国。

entries.zh: 该蜂巢通过专职化的半独立领袖获得了进化优势。尽管这些“子嗣”需要持续受到监管，但它们还是大大提高了整体的效率。
entries.en: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.

entries.zh:
在遥远的启始之时，先祖已有之。

在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的生活困苦且充满竞争，而强大的先祖还是能够开疆拓土。统治如此巨大的疆域很快难以为继，因此先祖创造了第一个子嗣。很快发现，子嗣显然无法自行管理一切，反之他们产出低级工蜂来帮助管理我们的家园。

让我们第一次试探性地跨出[capital_scope.System.GetName]的一步，我们的先祖便将自己隔绝于一个特化的巢穴中。受益于这些更好更流畅的控制体系，我们已经时刻准备着将先祖的影响力投射于整个星系了，正如他过去和现在所做一般，直至未来。而[Root.GetName]将见证一切。
entries.en:
In the beginning, the Progenitor was.

Life on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] was harsh and competitive, yet still the mighty Progenitor expanded its territory. Running such a vast dominion soon grew untenable, so the Progenitor created the first Offspring. In time, it became apparent that the Offspring could not manage alone. In turn, they produced menial drones to assist in taming our home.

As we took our first tentative steps across the [capital_scope.System.GetName] system, our Progenitor sequestered itself into a specialized nest. Endowed with greater, streamlined control, we are now ready to spread our Progenitor's influence to all the stars of the galaxy - for the Progenitor was, is, and will be. The [Root.GetName] will see it so.

entries.zh:
在遥远的启始之时，先祖已有之。

虚空之中的生活困苦且充满竞争，然而强大的先祖仍能不断成长，虫群不断增殖，填满了这艘巨大飞船的每一层甲板、每一间舱室。随着要统御的意识越来越多，局势很快难以为继，于是先祖创造了第一个子嗣。随着时间推移，子嗣们也逐渐难以独自承担管理之责。于是，它们又创造出了低级工蜂来引导这场伟大的迁徙。

随着我们的舰队不断壮大，先祖将自己闭关在一艘专门的指挥舰中。在获得了更强大、更高效的统御能力之后，我们已经时刻准备着将先祖的影响力投射于整个星系了，正如他过去和现在所做一般，直至未来。而[Root.GetName]将见证一切。
entries.en:
In the beginning, the Progenitor was.

Life in the void is harsh and competitive, yet still the mighty Progenitor grew, its swarm multiplying, filling every deck and chamber of the great vessel. Directing so many minds soon grew untenable, so the Progenitor created the first Offspring. In time, it became apparent that the Offspring could not manage alone. In turn, they produced menial drones to assist in guiding the great migration.

As our fleet grew, our Progenitor sequestered itself into a specialized command vessel. Endowed with greater, streamlined control, we are now ready to spread our Progenitor's influence to all the stars of the galaxy, for the Progenitor was, is, and will be. The [Root.GetName] will see it so.

entries.zh: 该蜂巢的始祖。是该蜂巢最大也是最复杂的成员。
entries.en: The Progenitor of this hive. The largest and most sophisticated member of the hive.

entries.zh: 始祖的巢穴，是每一个子嗣出生的地方。
entries.en: The Progenitor's nest, where every single Offspring is born.

entries.zh: 曾经强大的始祖已经被征服，只留下处于混乱的蜂群。
entries.en: The once-mighty Progenitor has been vanquished, which has left the swarm in disarray.

entries.zh: 一束神经网络的丝线，从附属世界的一处分离蜂巢延伸而来。在那遥远的生物质中孕育的新工蜂，将沿着它被引向这个世界。
entries.en: A strand of the neural network reaching back from a Splinter Hive on a subject world. New workers gestated in that distant biomass are drawn along it to this world.

entries.zh: 子嗣之中的长子可能继承逝去始祖的衣钵。
entries.en: Our oldest offspring might be capable of shouldering the mantle of our departed Progenitor.

entries.zh: 该蜂巢正失去它们的始祖并处于混乱中。
entries.en: This hive is missing its progenitor and is in disarray.

entries.zh: 在星际战争中，这座蜂巢如果未被子嗣舰船监管，将会遭受严重的削弱。
entries.en: This hive is disadvantaged during stellar combat if the battle is not overseen by an Offspring ship.

entries.zh: 难以置信的事情发生了。我们的首都已落入卑鄙的[From.GetName]的[From.species.GetHandNamePlural]手中。在最近[Root.GetName]的绝望的防御战中，我们的先祖落入了令人憎恶的入侵者的受众，并带走了许多[From.GetSpeciesAdj]。\n\n为了以防万一，我们深思熟虑的先祖已经在诸多子嗣中安排好了继位者。这位备选继位者能够稳定我们蜂巢意识的一部分，但重新管控整个意识的复杂性和压力超出其能力范畴。在敌人趁我们陷入短暂的混乱而获取更大优势之前，我们必须尽快催熟这位子嗣，使其成为新的一位先祖。
entries.en: The unimaginable has happened. Our capital has fallen into the [From.species.GetHandNamePlural] of the despicable [From.GetName]. During the last desperate defense of [Root.GetName], our Progenitor fell to the horrid invaders, taking many of the [From.GetSpeciesAdj] with them.\n\nIn case of the unthinkable, our ever-calculating Progenitor had designated a successor among the Offspring. The Progenitor-in-waiting has managed to stabilize parts of our consciousness, but the complexity and pressure are too great for it to fully take up the mantle. We will have to incubate this Offspring and have it take over as a new Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of our momentary disunity.

entries.zh: 难以置信的事情发生了。我们的母星已落入卑鄙的[From.GetName]的[From.species.GetHandNamePlural]手中。我们现在不得不把所有的行政能力转移到[capital_scope.GetName]，包括配备新的始祖巢穴。在敌人开始利用我们暂时的分崩离析前，我们必须将其中一个后裔孵化为新的始祖。
entries.en: The unimaginable has happened. Our homeworld has fallen into the [From.species.GetHandNamePlural] of the despicable [From.GetName]. We now have to move all our administrative efforts to [capital_scope.GetName], including setting up a new Progenitor Nest. We will have to incubate one of our Offspring and have it take over as a new Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of our momentary disunity.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]遭到了可怖的§Y[From.GetAdj]§!巨像武器的打击。我们失去的不仅仅是这个星球，还有我们的始祖以及所有居住在这个[Root.GetPlanetHabitat]上的子嗣。[Root.GetName]上的每一个子嗣和子个体都集结在一起，尽全力保护我们的始祖不受这个可怕武器的攻击。最终，它们的所有努力都只不过是延缓了无可避免的厄运，始祖很快陨落了。\n\n现在我们的主体意识里满是矛盾碰撞的思想和冲动。如果我们不马上指派一名新的始祖，[Owner.GetName]很快就会停止生命。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] has been struck with a Colossus weapon from the dreaded §Y[From.GetAdj]§!. We lost not only the world but also our Progenitor, and all Offspring residing on the [Root.GetPlanetHabitat]. Every drone and Offspring on [Root.GetName] had gathered in an effort to protect our Progenitor from the dreaded machine. In the end, their efforts did naught but prolong the inevitable, and the Progenitor fell soon after.\n\nNow our consciousness is full of clashing thoughts and impulses. If we do not appoint a new Progenitor soon, then the [Owner.GetName] will cease to be.

entries.zh: 在持续数月的轰炸后，一切都结束了。[From.GetName]陷落了，一切生命的迹象都消失了。在厚厚的尘埃云在由我们前首都化作的废墟街道中翻腾。死亡的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]曝尸荒野，在我们中最伟大的一员，我们的先祖的身边堆作尸山，而先祖也在最后的轰炸中随之而去。\n\n我们现在不得不把所有的行政能力转移到[capital_scope.GetName]，并且需要建立新的始祖巢穴。在敌人开始利用我们暂时的分崩离析前，我们必须将其中一个子嗣孵化为新的始祖。
entries.en: After many months of bombardment, it is over. [From.GetName] has fallen, all trace of life has been eradicated. Dust clouds billow across the ruined streets of our former capital. Dead [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]  litter the ground, culminating in an enormous pile of corpses surrounding the greatest of us all - our Progenitor, which finally fell during the final bombardment.\n\nWe now have to move our administration to [capital_scope.GetName], and it will be necessary to establish a new Progenitor Nest. We will have to incubate one of our Offspring to assume the role of Progenitor before any more of our enemies take advantage of this moment of disunity.

entries.zh: 我们在$PLANET|Y$上的子嗣已经被击败，这导致了我们的§Y子嗣巢穴§!被摧毁。
entries.en: Our Offspring on $PLANET|Y$ has been defeated, leading to the destruction of our §YOffspring Nest§!.

entries.zh: 我们目前并没有将子个体派遣到$PLANET|Y$上的§Y子嗣巢穴§!，这会导致工人子个体的效率降低。
entries.en: We currently do not have a drone assigned to a §YOffspring Nest§! on $PLANET|Y$, leading to a decrease in worker drone productivity.

我们在$SYSTEM|Y$恒星系中最后一艘§Y子嗣舰船§!被击败，我们的舰队失去了必要的指挥控制。
entries.en: Our last §YOffspring Ship§! in the $SYSTEM|Y$ system has fallen, leaving our fleets without proper command.

entries.en: The administrator of the entire planet resides here. It is through Offspring drones that the Progenitor enacts their grand design.

entries.en: This fortified nest safely harbors the local Offspring while also accelerating growth for the rest of the nearby hive.

entries.en: \n§HOnly Progenitor Hive-Minded species may be assembled by the Offspring Nest.§!\n

entries.zh: 这些陆军被当地的始祖直接监管，它们不仅更加致命，而且比普通蜂巢能产出的任何士兵的生命力都更加顽强。
entries.en: Under the direct supervision of the local Offspring, the armies are both deadlier and more challenging to kill than anything a regular hive-mind could produce.

entries.zh: 该星球正缺乏子嗣，导致$pop_cat_simple_drone$效率显著下滑。
entries.en: This planet is missing an Offspring leading to a significant drop in $pop_cat_simple_drone$ efficiency.

entries.zh: 作为子嗣，这艘船可以投射始祖的意志。
entries.en: As an Offspring, this ship is capable of projecting the Progenitor's will.

entries.zh: 能够让子嗣监管并指挥恒星系内正在进行的战斗的恒星基地模块。\n
entries.en: A starbase module allowing an Offspring to oversee and administrate ongoing battles within the system.\n

entries.zh: 这个物种也许永远也不会知道自己的祖先为什么会迁移到地表以下。这究竟是出于一种自我保存的必要，或是为了追寻资源的富足？不管其目的为何，他们都成功地适应了环境，造就了一个对环境要求更加灵活的社会。
entries.en: This civilization may never know why their ancestors migrated below the surface. Was it necessary to ensure self-preservation, or did the promise of bountiful resources allure them? Whatever the case, they successfully adapted, leading to a more environmentally versatile community.

entries.zh: 该这明已经完美地融入了地下的存在，其最初的驱动力或是是某种经过深思熟虑的自我保护，或是某种在深处寻找隐藏的丰富资源的指令。由此产生的机械适应性早已挖掘出了一个多功能且坚定不移的机器社群。
entries.en: This civilization has flawlessly integrated into subterranean existence, initially driven by either calculated self-preservation or a directive to locate of hidden, abundant resources in the depths. The resulting mechanical adaptations have unearthed a versatile and unwavering community of machines.

entries.zh: 当[GetHomeWorldName]上的其他生命在只能在荒野中度过夜晚，我们的祖先很快学习到了在地下生活的智慧，地下为他们提供了阻挡猛烈阳光和剧烈气候的庇荫。\n\n$START_SCREEN_SUBTERRANEAN_END$
entries.en: While other beings on [GetHomeWorldName] would spend their nights out in the wilds, our ancestors soon learned the wisdom of underground dwellings, sheltered from harsh light and climates.\n\n$START_SCREEN_SUBTERRANEAN_END$

entries.zh: [GetHomeWorldName]上的生命采取了一些完全不同的进化路线。和我们同处一颗星球的其他生命形式不同，它们从阳光中汲取能量而我们从阴暗的地底获得营养，正如我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖所做的那样。\n\n$START_SCREEN_SUBTERRANEAN_END$
entries.en: Life on [GetHomeWorldName] has taken some radically different routes. Unlike the other lifeforms with whom we share this world, deriving their energy from sunlight: we take our nutrients from deep within the murky ground, as our [GetSpeciesAdj] ancestors did.\n\n$START_SCREEN_SUBTERRANEAN_END$

entries.zh: 我们生于[GetHomeWorldName]极深的地下。我们的进化之路和我们那些不可移动的表兄弟不同，他们在上方如同哨兵般环卫者我们，而我们却选择远离严酷而闪耀的日光。和他们不同，我们获得了移动、思考以及建立一个文明的能力。\n\n$START_SCREEN_SUBTERRANEAN_END$
entries.en: We are born from the very depths of [GetHomeWorldName]. Away from the harsh glare of starlight, our evolutionary path diverged from that of our immobile cousins, who remain like sentinels above and around us. Unlike them, we gained the ability to move, think, and form a civilization.\n\n$START_SCREEN_SUBTERRANEAN_END$

entries.zh: 对地底矿物的轻易获取让我们的[GetSpeciesAdj]先祖完成了工业化，统一了我们的物种并深化了穴居的文明形式。我们数次尝试重回地表但每次都只能带来残酷而难于应付的回忆。因此我们还是留在了地下，在星球的根基处建立我们至高无上的地位。\n\n现在随着我们首台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的发现，我们做出了有史以来最大胆的尝试。如同我们的祖先在黑暗中的开拓一般，我们必须在星间的虚空中开凿出我们自己的新家园。
entries.en: Easy access to the below-ground minerals allowed our [GetSpeciesAdj] predecessors to industrialize, unifying our species and furthering our cavernous civilization. There were numerous attempts to return to the surface, but each time, it proved brutal and unforgiving. So, we remained below, establishing our dominance within our planet's foundations.\n\nNow, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. Just as our ancestors did in the darkness below the surface, we must now carve out homes in the void between the stars.

entries.zh:
我们诞生于[GetHomeWorldName]深深的地下，但并不知道为什么离我们而去的创造者要深掘到地表之下。然而，这一定也是最佳的决定，因为我们现在已经是这里硕果仅存的文明了。

由于很容易获取去地下的矿物，我们先前的无数迭代得以欣欣向荣。在确保了对星球地下世界的掌控之后，我们最终征服了地表。

如今，随着第一台[GetStartingDrivePlural]的研发，我们将迈出最大胆的一步。前往繁星之间，并且，一如既往地，在无尽的黑暗中凿刻出我们的新家园。
entries.en:
Constructed in the depths of [GetHomeWorldName], we do not know why our bygone creators decided to dwell beneath the surface. Yet, it must have been the optimal decision, as we are now the only civilization remaining.

Easy access to minerals below ground allowed our previous iterations to thrive. We finally claimed the surface after establishing our dominance within the planet's foundation.

Now, with the discovery of our first [GetStartingDrivePlural], we make our boldest attempt yet. To reach out to the stars - and as before, we shall carve out homes from this darkness.

entries.zh: §R警告：禁用除['concept_psionic_ascension']以外所有的飞升路线。§!\n\n早在他们踏入星系舞台之前，他们的文明就受到了虚境行者集会的支持和塑造成型。
entries.en: §RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].§!\n\nLong before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.

entries.zh:
我们的祖先流传下来关于导师的神话：他们无所不知，并且塑造了我们文明的早期阶段。通过托梦，他们从遥远的地方与我们交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，他教会了我们星际航行的秘诀。在短短的几年后，我们便能够建造舰船遨游太空。

不过我们前方的路还有多长？我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。创建我们自己的隧道便可以让我们通过这条路拜访导师。在我们踏入星际舞台之际，愿我们的导师继续赐予我们更多的智慧。
entries.en:
The myths of our forebears speak of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who helped to shape our earliest civilization. Through dreams, they approached us from afar, sharing their wisdom of the Shroud and its teachings.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have provided us with the key to interstellar travel. In just a few years, we have built vessels capable of traversing the void.

But how much farther is it possible to go? Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. Spawning our own Tunnel should give us a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our first steps onto the galactic stage.

entries.zh:
我们教会的创始人如此描述导师：他们无所不知无所不能，他们降下了最初的福音。通过托梦，他们从遥远的地方与我们交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，他教会了我们星际航行的秘诀。在短短的几年后，我们便能够建造舰船遨游太空。

但这并不是我们雄心壮志的尽头。我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。如果我们创建好了这条神圣的通路，我们便能直接与导师会面。在我们踏入星际舞台之际，愿我们的导师继续赐予我们更多的智慧。
entries.en:
The founders of our church wrote of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who helped to shape our earliest gospels. Through dreams, they approached us from afar, sharing their wisdom of the holy Shroud.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have provided us with the key to interstellar travel. In just a few years, we have built vessels capable of seeding our holy truth throughout the stars.

But that must not mark the limit of our ambition. Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. If we but spawn this holy conduit, we would possess a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our first steps onto the galactic stage.

entries.zh:
我们的祖先流传下来关于导师的神话：他们无所不知，早在我们记忆产生之前就开始指引我们。通过托梦，他们跨越虚空与我们流浪中的先祖交流，将他们关于虚境的知识和智慧传授于我们。

如今我们的导师再次降临，通过在我们的梦境中播撒下光怪陆离的画面，告诉我们连接两颗恒星间的不只有缓慢漂流这一条路，还有一条穿越虚境本身、转瞬之间跨越浩瀚距离的途径。

不过我们前方的路还有多长？我们的导师指明了“虚境隧道”这条路，那是一个坐落于他们母星系边陲的天然虫洞。我们若能创建自己的隧道，便可以通过这条路拜访导师。愿我们立足于群星之间时，导师能继续赐予我们智慧。
entries.en:
The myths of our forebears speak of the Teachers - beings of great knowledge and power who have guided our people since before memory. Through dreams, they reached across the void to our wandering ancestors, sharing their wisdom of the Shroud and its teachings.

Now our Teachers have reached out once again. Seeding our dreams with eldritch visions, they have revealed a path beyond the slow drift between stars - a way to traverse the Shroud itself, crossing vast distances in moments.

But how much farther is it possible to go? Our Teachers refer to a 'Shroud Tunnel' - a natural wormhole that sits at the edge of their home system. Spawning our own Tunnel should give us a direct path to the Teachers themselves. May they continue to grant us wisdom as we take our place among the stars.

entries.zh: 我们的学生啊，我们已经教导了你们一代又一代，将虚境和它的奥秘的知识播撒入你们的梦境之中。现在你们已经能够触及星辰，你们真正的学徒生涯才刚刚开始。前路不会一马平川。为了照亮你们前行的道路，我们传授给你们虚境信标的知识，这是一个强大的设备。在你们的一座恒星基地上建造以后，这座信标会打开一个虚境隧道。请谨慎选择地点，因为虚境隧道只会生成一次。\n\n如果有所索求，有所不测就呼唤我们吧。在梦境中我们会一直看着你们。在漫游的旅途中，我们等待着你们的到来。
entries.en: Our students, for generations we have taught you, seeding our knowledge of the Shroud and its mysteries within your dreams. Now that you have reached the stars, your true apprenticeship is at hand. The path forward will not be an easy one. To light the way, we grant you knowledge of the Shroud Beacon, a device of great power. Once built on one of your starbases, the Beacon will spawn a Shroud Tunnel. Choose its location carefully, as you will not be able to spawn another.\n\nIn times of need and uncertainty, call on us. In dreams, we will be watching. In waking life, we await your arrival.

entries.zh: 学生们，我们在梦中曾指引你们。通过这些梦境我们塑造了你们的世界。如今你们已茁壮成长，可以将我们的信条传播于星际，你们真正的试炼正刚刚开始。你们的勤勉将光耀虚境，你们的辛劳成果亦是对你们教导的兑现。为了点燃事业之火，我们传授给你们虚境信标的知识，这是一个强大的设备。在你们的一座恒星基地上建造以后，这座信标会打开一个虚境隧道。请谨慎选择地点，因为虚境隧道只会生成一次。\n\n如果有所索求，有所不测就呼唤我们吧。在梦境中我们会一直看着你们。在漫游的旅途中，我们等待着你们的到来。
entries.en: Students, in dreams we have guided you. Through visions, we have shaped your world. Now that you stand ready to export our doctrine to the stars, your true apprenticeship is at hand. Through your work shall the Shroud be honored. The profits of your labor shall fulfill the promise of our teachings. To stoke the fires of industry, we grant you knowledge of the Shroud Beacon, a device of great power. Once built on one of your starbases, the Beacon will spawn a Shroud Tunnel. Choose its location carefully, as you will not be able to spawn another.\n\nIn times of need and uncertainty, call on us. In dreams, we will be watching. In waking life, we await your arrival.

entries.zh: 我们心怀感激地接受你们的馈赠。
entries.en: We receive your gift with gratitude.

entries.zh: 学徒们，我们终于能和你们好好打招呼了。迹象和预兆都预示了这一刻，虚境本身也会见证你们的到来。我们已经期待了很久，只为与你们在感知之境相会。在这里你们是欢迎之至的存在。
entries.en: Apprentices, at last we can greet you properly. Signs and portents foretold this moment, and the Shroud itself has witnessed your passage. Long have we waited to meet with you in the realm of the senses. You are most welcome here.

entries.zh: 学徒们，我们终于能和你们好好打招呼了。通过早就铺设好的隧道，你们的到来已经被虚境所感知。你们的回声仍在颤抖、涟漪般回荡过潜意识的水面。虚境神秘中的居者一定会祝福我们的会面。在这里你们是最受欢迎的存在。
entries.en: Apprentices, at last we can greet you properly. Through the Tunnel long prepared, your passage has been felt by the Shroud itself. The echoes yet shiver, rippling through the waters of the unconscious mind. Those who dwell within the mysteries of the Shroud have surely blessed our meeting. You are most welcome here.

entries.zh: 在黑暗中漫无止境地摸索之后，虚境的面纱终于被揭开。我们的导师赐予了我们无上的珍宝。这个信标以及其诞生的隧道，注定会照亮我们跨越星际的航道。从这个星系开始的旅途将会更快……也远远地更为神秘。
entries.en: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Our Teachers have bestowed a great gift upon us. This Beacon, and the Tunnel it spawns, will surely light our way across the stars. Journeys from this system will now be faster... and infinitely more mysterious.

entries.zh: 愿虚境欢迎我们的到来。
entries.en: May the Shroud welcome our passage.

entries.zh: 在黑暗中漫无止境地摸索之后，虚境的面纱终于被揭开。我们的导师赐予了我们无上的珍宝。这个信标以及其召唤出的隧道，注定会照亮我们跨越星际的航道。\n\n还剩下一步：我们导师所居住的那一侧边界至今对我们封闭。地图中实际上的航道对虚境来说可能无关紧要，但是在这边的星球还是非常麻烦。至少现在，我们通过隧道的路径还是被封锁着。
entries.en: After a long period spent grasping in the dark, the veil that covers the Shroud has been lifted. Our Teachers have bestowed a great gift upon us. This Beacon, and the Tunnel it spawns, will surely light our way across the stars.\n\nOnly one step remains: the border beyond which our Teachers reside is closed to us. Lines on a map may be immaterial to the Shroud, but in this world they remain troublesome. For now, our passage through the Tunnel remains blocked.

entries.zh: 曾几何时，该文明的天空短暂地被流星所照亮，紧接着就陷入了长久的黑暗。此后他们试图冲出天际以寻求答案，并在第一次太空征程中发现了一座休眠中（并且早已被遗弃）的§H$quantum_catapult_1$§!。
entries.en: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) §H$quantum_catapult_1$§!.

entries.zh: 自上古以来我们的人民就能时不时地看到夜空被无数流星所照亮，但至今我们的科学家还是不能解释这种现象。随着我们开始探索星系，我们最终获得了追踪这些扰动现象原因的必要装备——一个被我们的工程师称为$quantum_catapult_1$的古老构造。\n\n$START_SCREEN_STAR_SLINGSHOT_SECOND_PART$
entries.en: Since time immemorial our people have seen the night sky occasionally lit up by innumerable shooting stars, and even until recently our scientists have been unable to explain the phenomenon. As we have started exploring the galaxy we have finally gotten the equipment necessary to track down the cause of these disturbances - an old structure our engineers have called a $quantum_catapult_1$.\n\n$START_SCREEN_STAR_SLINGSHOT_SECOND_PART$

entries.zh: 自我们鸿蒙初开之时便能时不时地看到天空被无数的流星所照亮，并完全无法理解是什么可能造成了这种奇怪的现象。随着我们终于脱出母星的桎梏，我们成功地获得了追踪这些扰动现象原因的必要工具——一个$quantum_catapult_1$。\n\n$START_SCREEN_STAR_SLINGSHOT_SECOND_PART$
entries.en: Since the earliest moments of our consciousness we have occasionally seen the sky lit up by innumerable shooting stars, and been unable to come to terms with what might cause this weird phenomenon. As we have freed ourselves from the shackles of our homeworld, we have managed to obtain the tools necessary to track down the cause of this disturbance - a $quantum_catapult_1$.\n\n$START_SCREEN_STAR_SLINGSHOT_SECOND_PART$

entries.zh: 尽管陷入休眠，部分被毁还遭到遗弃，我们依旧坚信其能回复往日的荣光。如果按照我们的预期工作，它将成为通往星系各处的星门。
entries.en: Though dormant, partly in ruins, and abandoned, we believe it can be restored to former glory. If it works as envisioned, it will be our gateway to the rest of the galaxy.

- $HOME_SYSTEM$ Nearby ruined ['concept_quantum_catapult_restored_slingshot'] with the ['concept_slingshot_digsite'] ['concept_archaeology_site']\n- ['concept_quantic_ambush'] Effects: Increased to §G+50%§! $MOD_SHIP_FIRE_RATE_MULT$

entries.zh: 我们终于获得了$quantum_catapult_1$所在的恒星系及其周边区域。现在我们可以送工程师过去以开始修复工程，这样就能让这个休眠的结构重获新生。
entries.en: We have finally secured the system and region around the broken $quantum_catapult_1$. Now at last, we can send engineers in to start the repair work necessary to bring this dormant structure back to life.

entries.zh: 我们已经找到了一个损毁的巨型结构残骸。该构造显然亟需修复，同时我们也在其数据库中发现了饱含着有关异星生物的见解的宝贵财富。尽管我们还在决定是否要重建这一远古科技的造物，我们的考古学家有机会去发掘并取回这宇宙设备起源的线索。它的其中一个发明者，“量子建筑师”相关的日志似乎格外有价值。恢复这些文件对我们解密遗留给我们科技的远古种族的文化和历史必然有着莫大的帮助。
entries.en: We have found the wreckage of a ruined megastructure. The construct is obviously in desperate need of repairs, and we've found a wealth of xenological insights in its databanks. While we're deciding whether to rebuild this ancient technology, our archaeologists have an opportunity to extract and recover clues to the origin of this cosmic device. A series of logs from one of the inventors, the 'Quantum Architect,' seems especially promising. Recovering files should help us decipher the culture and history of the ancient race that left us this tech.

entries.zh:
在蓝图和图示之中我们恢复了一份奇怪的文档：

这是来自量子建筑师的个人文件

鸿蒙之初，我们居于黑暗。上帝说：“要有黑暗”，于是世界充满了黑暗。当我们最初的祖先获得了知觉之光，我们就想在天空中搜寻生命的迹象和意义，但我们的头顶只有无际的黑暗。随着我们建立了文明，我们的思想扫过黑夜中的每一片阴影，我们在建立第一座城市的地方辛勤劳作，经常测试它们的地基。

数千年后，我突然莽撞地向“上”看了一眼。当其他人还面朝大地而劳作时，我的思绪却向天空打开。我建造了电路和钢铁的神殿，用我的智慧之光制作了我自己的工具。通过完善二极管和电容器的迷宫，我将我的意识传播到整个宇宙，感知笼罩在我们世界的黑暗之外的一切事物。

因为我能感受到其他人感受不到的东西：我们在宇宙并不孤独。通过玻璃般的黑暗，我能感受到数以千计的其他星球。我能感知到不可能。在我们无尽的黑夜之外是燎原般的万千星点。
entries.en:
Among blueprints and schematics, we recovered a strange document:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

In the beginning, we dwelled in darkness. Our gods said, 'let there be dark,' and there was. When our first ancestors gained the spark of sentience, we searched the heavens for signs of life or meaning, but all above us was darkness. As we built our civilization, our minds scanned for shadows in the night. We toiled in the places where we built our first cities, always testing their foundations.

Thousands of years later, I had the temerity to look *up*.While others labored with their gaze downcast, my mind opened up to the heavens. Building a temple of circuitry and steel, I formed my own tools, empowered by the light of my intellect. Perfecting a labyrinth of diodes and capacitors, I cast my consciousness through the cosmos, perceiving something beyond the dark skies that shrouded our world.

For I could sense what others could not: We were not alone in the universe. As though through a glass darkly, I could detect thousands of other worlds. I could sense the impossible. Beyond the night burned a thousand points of light.

entries.zh:
尽管我们的探险队还在筛选能够解码该巨型结构的建造计划的数据，他们已经发现了另一个看起来像是宗教文本的摘录：

来自量子建筑师的个人文件

我吐露真相，而我的人民却回以混乱。
我们每个人都在自己思想和情感的迷雾中麻木劳作。我们试探性地对他人伸出手，但我们中有太多人是孤独的。我们的神在黑暗中创造了世界，我们被告知说我们才是神的造物的中心。

就因为我胆敢梦想天外的世界，我的愿景就被他人认为是谎言。我们当中的其他人问：怎么才能证明这些梦？我们怎么能相信我们不能证明的事？作为回应，我将那些还愿意听我的人引到自己的实验室。这些最聪明的头脑可以感知到我所能感知到的：夜幕之外的其他星球。

而最黑暗的头脑却报之以其他的回应，他们捏造新的论点，紧握致命的武器。那些危险的头脑吟唱寓言，说我们的星球会陷入动荡，因为我们不再是神的宠儿。然而我还是知道真相：创造之光是一幅巨大的帷幕。查宇宙之秘，我被欣喜的浪潮所裹挟，渐渐失去了自己的身份。
entries.en:
While our expedition keeps sifting through the data to decode the megastructure's plans, they have found another excerpt of what looks like a religous text:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

I spoke the truth, and my people answered with chaos.
Each of us labors in our own fog of thoughts and emotions. We tentatively reach out to others, yet so many of us are alone. Our gods crafted the world from darkness, we are told, and we were allegedly the centerpiece of their creation.

Because I dared to dream of worlds beyond, I was told my vision was a lie. Who among us, others asked, could confirm these dreams? How can we believe, they said, what we cannot prove? And in response, I led those who would listen to my laboratory. The brightest minds could perceive a reflection of what I experienced: other worlds beyond the veil of night.

The darkest minds crafted other responses, formed new arguments, clutched deadly weapons. Dangerous minds sang that our world would be in turmoil, for we were no longer the favored spawn of the gods. Yet I knew the truth: Creation's illumination was a vast tapestry. Contemplating the majesty of the cosmos, I was swept away in tides of rapture, losing my identity.

entries.zh:
更多类弥赛亚的文本被恢复：

来自量子建筑师的个人文件

我不断地被无边无垠的宇宙所折磨和诱惑，开始考虑去遥远的世界并亲自体验。生活在被无尽黑夜包裹的世界中，其他的头脑做着美梦，而我寻求于他们进行交流。在黑暗之外有光明指引着我，光明诱惑着我，给予了我无限的启示。因此我把我的思想广播到遥远而未知的世界……

天上如是，地上亦然。我对天空的愿景带给了我喜悦，在地上，我同样找到了给我同样的解脱的幸福的人。我与另一个科学家坠入爱河，那是一位有远见的人，用其他的办法在群星中寻求我所感知到的世界。

我们并不只是分享各自所见。我们立誓成为对方终生的伴侣。随着工作的进展，我们依偎在每一个漫漫长夜。我的伴侣梦到了星舰的设计图，在蜡制设计版中刻出原始的太阳能航空器。我不断用电路修修补补，努力将我的思想和无限融合起来。我的冒险越是深入，我内心的欣喜就越是充盈。多么美妙啊！永无止境的欢愉！
entries.en:
More of the quasi messianic figure's writings have been recovered:

From the personal files of the Quantum Architect

Tormented and tantalized by a boundless cosmos, I contemplated the means to travel to distant worlds and experience them firsthand. Enshrouded beyond the endless night, other minds dreamed, and I sought communion with them. Beyond a great darkness, a great Light led me on, offering me temptations and endless revelations. And thus I cast my mind out further into the unknown...

As above, so below. My visions of the heavens brought me joy, but down below, I found someone who brought me the same liberation of happiness. I fell in love with another scientist, a visionary who spoke of other ways to seek the stars I had sensed in my reveries.

We did more than share a vision. We pledged ourselves as partners for life. And as our work progressed, we stayed up later each night. My partner dreamed designs for starships, etching crude solar-powered spacecraft on their wax design board. I tinkered with circuitry, straining to unify my mind with infinity. The farther I ventured, the more my rapture grew. Such bliss! The ecstasy of endless eternity!

entries.zh:
来自量子建筑师的个人文件，其身份为宇宙制船师的伴侣

我的伴侣十分耐心而我却有些莽撞。我的挚爱拥有科学和逻辑的智慧而我也有着驰骋的心际。随着我们漫漫长夜中愈行愈远，我徒劳地将自己的意识广播到虚空。我忽视了睡眠，忽视了饥饿，最终也忽视了我的挚爱。我们在宇宙中追寻梦想的同时，内心却开始出现了鸿沟。

我的挚爱为这种现象创造了一个词：量子纠缠。我的身体还在这儿，但思想却驰骛天外，竭力地探寻欣喜和与永恒的交流。我的伴侣跟我说其他话，但我丝毫听不进去。“吾爱”，我的伴侣说，“回到我的身边”，但我却只能听到恒星的回声。

很快就到了测试我伴侣的太阳能星舰的时候。我志愿驾驶这架飞船。当我第一次掌舵并开始处女航之时，我将梦到通往遥远海岸的航线，我的身还在原处，心已神游天外。

我的挚爱渐渐平静下来，我会赐予我的挚爱无限，通往永恒，来吾道夫先路。我会给予我的挚爱万千世界之梦。
entries.en:
From the personal files of the Quantum Architect, partner of the Cosmic Shipwright

My partner was patient, and I was reckless. My Beloved had science and logic, and I had my psychic reveries. Longer and longer into the night, I vainly attempted to cast my consciousness into the void. I neglected sleep. I neglected food. I neglected My Beloved. As we pursued our dreams of venturing into the cosmos, a gulf grew between us.

My Beloved found words for our phenomenon: quantum entanglement. My body was here, but my mind was eons away, desperately seeking ecstasy and a communion with eternity. My partner told me other words, but I would not listen. 'My Love,' they said, 'come back to me,' but I could only hear the echoes of the stars.

Soon, the time will come to test my partner's solar starship. I have volunteered sit at the controls. As I sit at the helm of its first test flight, I will dream of a course to distant shores, my mind *here* and my body *there*.

My Beloved has grown quiet, but I will gift them with infinity, blazing a trail to eternity. I will offer them the dreams of a thousand worlds.

entries.zh:
来自宇宙制船师的个人文件，其身份为量子建筑师的遗孀

我们的第一艘星舰一年前就消失了。我们至今不知道之前到底发生了什么。我的伴侣，量子建筑师，他只留下了遗产和谜团。我们所能做的最深入的推测也不过是我的挚爱最终成为了宇宙中的一员。在他坐上控制面板之前开始处女航，他与无限融合在了一起，被对天空的狂喜和遐想所吞没。我们的测试船再也没有回来。

现在我只能用手头上粗糙的工具劳作，将我已经一片狼藉的工作和生活重拾起来。我更多的太阳能舰船开始了前往永夜的旅途。我开始着手安装更好的引擎，原型引擎能够让我们的舰船穿越超空间。在某些夜晚，我梦想着有一种技术可以将我们送往未知的星系，就像我失去的伴侣的思想和灵魂那样。

我向光明伸出手臂，拒绝向黑暗屈服。我坐在我的挚爱的实验室中，就像现在那样阅读他们的日志并写下自己的日志。有时候当一切陷入至暗，我尝试着把我的思想广播向宇宙。这是无限的信标。
entries.en:
From the personal files of the Cosmic Shipwright, widow of the Quantum Architect

Our first starship vanished a year ago. We still do not know precisely what happened. My partner, the Quantum Architect, has left behind a legacy and a mystery. As far as we can derive, My Love finally became one with the cosmos. Sitting at the controls aboard our first test flight, they merged with infinity, overwhelmed by rapturous psychic contemplation of the heavens. Our test ship never returned.

Now I labor with my own crude tools, left to reforge my work and my life from the wreckage. More of my solar starships have begun their journeys into the Great Night. I have begun work on better engines, prototypes that can propel our vessels through hyperspace. And on some nights, I dream of a technology that can leap for the stars like the mind and soul of my lost partner, launching us into the unknown.

As I reach for the light, I refuse to succumb to the darkness. I sit in My Love's laboratory, just as I am now, reading their journals and writing my own. And sometimes, when all is darkest, I attempt to cast my own mind across the cosmos. Infinity beckons.

entries.zh:
随着我们终于找到了该结构建造计划的缺失文件，我们还原了最后的文本：

来自宇宙制船师的文件，其身份为量子建筑师的遗孀

我们探寻了许多方法以实现我的挚爱的创新，也就是他们的量子创造。我不知道我们是否可以沿着这条看似莽撞的道路，以量子建筑师的设计为蓝本，以缓慢的步伐抵达群星。我寻求能跨越超空间的浪潮，思考着能将我们带到遥远彼岸的流向。

我的舰船沿着缓慢的路线前进，在深夜中我读着我的挚爱的日志，努力理解其中的数学表达式和相关机理。当我的思想触及无限时，我意识到我的挚爱还在那儿。他引导了先路，我必须跟着前行。

通过失去我却反而获得了灵感。我们曾开始制造过一个伟大的机械，它能够推动我们的舰船跨越星系，就如同我的挚爱跨入无限那样。当我离开时，我谦逊地要求这台宇宙设备以及其迭代更新产物应该纳入量子建筑师的个人日志。当其他人读到这篇日志时，毫无疑问我的灵魂已经飞往远方。我会找到在无垠的宇宙中和我的挚爱团聚的道路。因为我知道我们将共同居住在永恒中，梦想并漂流在万千星点之中。
entries.en:
As we finally found the missing pieces for the structure plans, we also recovered one last text:

From the files of the Cosmic Shipwright, widow of the Quantum Architect

We have searched for ways to employ My Love's innovations, their quantum creations. I am left wondering if we can take that same reckless path, empowered by the Quantum Architect's designs, but I reach for the stars at a slower pace. I search for a wave to ride through hyperspace, contemplating a current that will take us to distant shores.

My ships take the slow route, but late at night, I read My Love's journals, struggling to tame their mathematics and machinations. As my mind reaches out towards eternity, I know in my heart that My Love is still out there. They blazed a trail towards heaven, and I must follow.

Through loss, I have found inspiration. We have begun work on a grand machine that will propel our ships across the galaxy, just as My Beloved leapt into infinity. And someday, I will do what they have done. When I am gone, I humbly request that this cosmic device and all its iterations should include the personal logs of the Quantum Architect. Doubtless by the time others read this, my soul will have taken taken flight. I will have found a way to join My Beloved out there in the vast expanse. For I know that we will dwell in eternity together, dreaming and drifting through a thousand points of light.

entries.zh: 第一次飞出母星的经历是一段痛苦的回忆，一眨眼的功夫，我们就惨遭征服并跪倒在其脚下。不过现在我们终于得以展望未来，一个不必处在他国阴影之下的未来。
entries.en: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.

entries.zh:
当我们第一次离开母星系时，就遇到了一个迫使我们臣服的外星帝国。尽管对于人民而言这是一段痛苦的记忆，但事实证明这段附庸关系远比我们想象中有益得多，在这段短暂的附庸时光中，我们学到了不少东西。

我们并非宗主国唯一的附庸，因为我们已经接见了其他在宗主国控制下国家所派出的外交官和大使。虽然我们与其中的某些家伙看不对眼，但至少现在他们还是有用的盟友。

不过，我们虽然盼望着有朝一日能独立自主地决定自身的命运，但现在还是要接受当下的附属国地位，并充分利用目前的局面。
entries.en:
As we stepped out of our home system for the first time we were approached by a foreign empire who demanded our subjugation. Though a painful memory for our people, we have learned a lot in our short time as a vassal, with the relationship proving more beneficial than we could have hoped for.

We are not the only vassal of our new overlord, as we have had the chance to meet diplomats and ambassadors from some of the other empires under their thumb. We do not see quite eye to eye with some of them, but we believe they will prove to be useful allies for the time being.

Though we are looking forward to a day where we once again can decide our own future, we will accept our subject nature for now, and make the most of the situation we have been put in.

entries.en: An ambitious overlord who has spent considerable time and efforts in subduing their closest neighbors to serve their every need. They are slowly growing more indolent as they devolve more and more responsibility to their vassals.

entries.en: An empire that relies heavily upon their vassals, rarely interested in much beyond their home systems. They do not engage others in combat, nor actively expand their own borders unless forced to.

entries.zh: 欢迎你们，新外星人朋友们！\n\n由于你们选择成为我们的……盟友，我们认为现在正是与你们联络的时候。你们选择了理性而不是逼迫我们使用暴力，这令我们非常愉快。
entries.en: Welcome, dear newfound allies!\n\nWe felt it was only right to contact you now that you have chosen to partake in our... alliance. It pleases us you chose to see reason, rather than forcing our hand towards violence.

entries.en: You didn't give us much of a choice, did you?

entries.zh: 我们以成为你们的一员而骄傲！
entries.en: We are proud to be a part of your alliance!

entries.zh: 我们会对宗主国采取§G友好§!态势。

entries.zh: 我们同样骄傲于你们的到来！\n\n$origin.5705.desc$
entries.en: And we are proud to welcome you!\n\n$origin.5705.desc$

entries.zh: 经过深思熟虑，我们决定投资一大笔资源来援助你们的国家进行特化。在未来，这将让你们的帝国在我们所有的伙伴和盟友中扮演更加重要的角色。\n\n我们还不太确定你们的人民更喜欢怎么样的角色，军事化？专精学术？或你们更感兴趣矿物和物质财富？
entries.en: After careful consideration, we have decided to invest a significant amount of resources into helping you specialize your empire. It will enable your empire to play an important role in the future of all our friends and allies.\n\nWe were not entirely sure what your people would be more comfortable with, however: a militarized specialization? A scholarly one? Or are you more interested in materials and minerals?
So... Have you given it a second thought?

entries.en: Could you tell us more about Prospectoria?

entries.zh:
一种趋于暴力的倾向，是这样吗？

我们通常所说的戍邦是一种致力于军事事务的国家。这意味着我们会按月度支援你们一些基础的矿物和食物，这样你们国家可以将更多的精力放在战争上。

作为回报，我们希望你们可以为我们抵御外辱，在我们联盟的边境上扮演重要角色。这么说你们觉得可以接受吗？
entries.en:
A tendency towards violence, is that it?

A Bulwark, as we usually refer to them, are empires specialized in military affairs. It means we would support you with some basic minerals and food on a monthly basis so you could set aside a larger part of your empire to focus on war.

In turn, we expect you to help us defend against external threats, and play an important role at the borders of our allied space. Does that sound agreeable to you?

entries.zh: 听起来是我们可以接受的。
entries.en: That sounds like something we could live with.

entries.zh:
所以这引起了你们的兴趣不是吗？

我们通常所说的学邦是一种专精于研究科技的国家。我们承诺保护你们的国家，而你们便可以集中资源让国家以及我们的盟友更加先进。

作为回报我们希望你们可以与我们其他国家分享所有令人惊奇的科学发现。这样的合约是否令你们满意？
entries.en:
So they have piqued your interest, have they?

A Scholarium, as they are known, is an empire specialized in science and research. We would pledge to protect your empire so you can focus most of your resources on advancing your empire and our allies alike.

In turn we expect you to share any peculiar peculiar technological breakthroughs you might have with the rest of us. Would that sort of contract work for you?

entries.zh: 我们的人民乐于接受这项协定。
entries.en: Our people would be happy with that deal.

entries.zh:
你们对这项协定感兴趣没错吧？

勘探邦，正如大众赋予其称呼，是一种专精于发现矿物、生产战略资源的国家——但这会以牺牲他们的科学发展能力为代价。通过合适的工具，一些勘探邦可以找到其他人容易忽略的稀有矿物，尽管这只是我们道听途说的。

这听起来对你们的人民而言是不是一项可以胜任的工作呢？
entries.en:
Interested in that deal, are you?

A Prospectorium, as many call them, is an empire which specializes in finding minerals, and manufacturing strategic resources - but often at the cost of advancing their empire scientifically. With the right tools, some of the Prospectoria have been able to locate rare minerals that others overlook, though that's only a rumor we have heard.

Does that sound like something your people would be able to do?

entries.zh: 我认为这非常适合我们。
entries.en: We believe that is something that would fit us.

entries.zh: 我们接见了由宗主派来的一小支外交使团，带来了最新的消息和指令。由于我们近期对于他们要求的满足，他们希望签订一项更为详细的协定来推进我们之间的关系。
entries.en: We have received a small diplomatic corps from our overlord, bringing the latest news and demands. As we have but recently submitted to their will, they want to define our relationship moving forward with a more elaborate and detailed pact.

entries.zh: 紧随着[overlord_ruler.GetName]的突然驾崩，我们获悉了[Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName]上正经历的混乱。不太受支持的[overlord_heir.GetName]通过军事手段将王座纳入了[overlord_heir.GetHimselfHerself]的囊中，令[overlord_heir.GetHisHer]的皇亲和[Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName]上的人民们大为不满。\n\n在[overlord_heir.GetFirstName]的引起骚乱的崛起之后，许多人开始质疑[Root.Overlord.GetName]统治我们的合法性。如果他们连自己首都的安全都无法保证，他们还有什么能耐来保护我们的安全？
entries.en: We have received news about the ongoing chaos on [Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName], following the sudden death of [overlord_ruler.GetName]. The unpopular [overlord_heir.GetName] has taken the throne for [overlord_heir.GetHimselfHerself] with the help of the military, much to the chagrin of [overlord_heir.GetHisHer] siblings and the people of [Root.Overlord.Capital.GetName].\n\nAfter the troublesome rise of [overlord_heir.GetFirstName], many have started questioning the right of the [Root.Overlord.GetName] to dominion over us. If they cannot keep their own capital peaceful, what hope do they possibly have to keep the rest of us safe?

entries.zh: 哪怕是天上的长堤，也是溃于蚁穴。
entries.en: A starfish rots from the head down.

entries.zh: 失去了能够维持团结统一的伟大领袖，[previous_overlord.GetName]现已分崩离析，而每一部分都宣称自己才是原先帝国的正统。然而由于没有足够的实力和合法性，他们对所有附庸的控制也随之瓦解。\n\n在每一个分裂的部分都在互相征伐，争夺[previous_overlord.GetName]的王位时，他们原先的附属国们也可以按自己的意愿行事了。
entries.en: With no great leader to hold them together, the [previous_overlord.GetName] has dissolved into several parts, with each claiming their right to rule over the old empire. Without the strength or legitimacy of old however, their hold over all their vassals has crumbled to nothing.\n\nWith the disparate parts of the old empire fighting over the throne of the [previous_overlord.GetName], their old subjects are now free to do as they wish.

entries.zh: 是时候有新的领袖登上历史舞台了。
entries.en: It is time for a new leader to take charge.

entries.zh: 对§Y[previous_overlord.GetName]§!和它原先的所有附属国获得§Y30年§!的§Y征服§!宣战理由。
entries.en: Gain a §YSubjugation§! Casus Belli against the §Y[previous_overlord.GetName]§! and all its old vassals for §Y30 years§!.

entries.zh: 我们忠于王座，无论如何。
entries.en: We are loyal to the throne - no matter what.

entries.zh: 我们将继续是§Y[previous_overlord.GetName]§!的忠诚附属国。
entries.en: Remain a loyal subject of the §Y[previous_overlord.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: [new_subject_target.GetName]的人民对他们国土以外的事情漠不关心，不过他们清楚，无论外界发生了什么都可能会破坏他们一心一意的内部专注。因此他们向我们寻求如同原先[previous_overlord.GetName]所给予的类似的保护。
entries.en: The people of the [new_subject_target.GetName] care little for anything outside their own borders, but they are aware that whatever is out there might ruin their single-minded internal focus. Therefore they have turned to us for protection of the same kind the [previous_overlord.GetName] once gave them.

entries.zh: 这对我们的帝国颇有裨益。
entries.en: They will be a boon to our empire.

entries.zh: 我们对这些科学家没什么兴趣。
entries.en: We have no interest in these scientists.

entries.zh: [new_subject_target.GetName]因其众多争执不休的王子们而臭名昭著，他们一直处心积虑想争取到每一点可以争取的影响力和权力。仅这一次他们似乎终于成功取得了一项共识，向我们派出了特使以期缔结新的外交条约。似乎他们开始怀念曾经[previous_overlord.GetName]给予的那种悉心呵护了。
entries.en: The [new_subject_target.GetName] is known for their many quarreling princes, all desperately trying to grab hold of whatever influence and power they can. For once it seems they have finally managed to agree to something, and have sent envoys looking to make a new diplomatic pact with us. It seems they are missing the protection the [previous_overlord.GetName] once gave them.

entries.zh: 行吧，至少他们能有点共识。
entries.en: As long as they can agree to something.

entries.zh: 我们对这群呱噪的家伙可没有半点兴趣。
entries.en: We are not interested in their quarrels.

entries.zh: 在[previous_overlord.GetName]崩溃之前，[new_subject_target.GetName]与之颇为相近，似乎他们有兴趣与我们建立发展相似的关系。他们的外交官正在连夜撰写一份能令双方都满意签署的外交协定，作为我们两个帝国相互之间建立起更加充分的理解的第一步。
entries.en: The [new_subject_target.GetName] was particularly close to [previous_overlord.GetName] before their dissolution, and it seems like they are interested in building a similar relationship to our empire moving forward. Now their diplomats are scrambling to finish a diplomatic deal both sides will be happy to sign, as the first step in building a better understanding between our two empires.

entries.zh: 这儿会有他们的容身之所的。
entries.en: We will find room for them.

entries.zh: 似乎[new_subject_target.GetName]的市场在[previous_overlord.GetName]解体后，有些不稳定。现在他们已经没有人可以依靠了。几位贸易巨头已与我们接触，并表示愿意提供[new_subject_target.GetAdj]劳役，甚至非常愿意献上部分利润，一旦他们的帝国稳定下来。
entries.en: It seems the markets of the [new_subject_target.GetName] have been somewhat unstable after the dissolution of the [previous_overlord.GetName], now that they no longer have someone to rely on for protection. Several trade princes have approached us and offered to support [new_subject_target.GetAdj] servitude, and even part of the profits that are sure to follow as their empire stabilizes once more.

entries.zh: 只要他们能乖乖交上能量币就行。
entries.en: As long as they can bring their energy credits.

entries.zh: 我们不需要他们的资本财产。
entries.en: We have no need of their capital wealth.

entries.zh: 尽管国防承包商的专业性毋庸置疑，但[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的国家不应当过于依赖私人的安保服务。
entries.en: While the professionalism of defense contractors is undeniable, the empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should not rely too heavily on private peacekeeping.

entries.zh: 为了星系的安全事务，我们应当向独立安全机构投资资源。这些训练有素、去政治化的专家可以帮助[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的成员国组织防御。
entries.en: In the interest of galactic security, we should invest resources in independent security agencies. These highly-trained and non-political professionals will help organize defense for the members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].

entries.zh: 由于冲突规模的升级，私人安保团队需要升级武力以继续完成他们一直以来做得最为出色的工作：保护[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的安全。
entries.en: As the scale of conflicts increases, private security outfits must be empowered to keep doing what they do best: keep the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] safe.

entries.zh: 战争或许是不可避免的，但是连带伤害并非是这样。通过将这方面的信任交给擅长防守的专家，[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]想必肯定可以显著地减少被报道的战争暴行。
entries.en: War might be inevitable, but collateral damage is not. By placing its trust in the hands of defense specialists, the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] is certain to dramatically reduce the number of reported war atrocities.

entries.zh: 尽管我们作了最大的努力，暴力的意识形态冲突依然在激化星系的局势。这些帝国不断地证明它们自己很喜欢就一些小的口角挑起争端。对它们的私人武装进行管制，就能让中立的防卫合同商更加有效率地执行维和行动。
entries.en: Despite our best efforts, violent ideological conflicts keep agitating the galaxy. Empires keep proving themselves prone to petty squabbles. Regulating their personal militaries is sure to allow neutral defense contractors to keep the peace more efficiently.

entries.zh: 通过规范成员国的边境，我们可以让星系对所有人都变得更安全和公平。尽管有些人可能会觉得官僚主义令人窒息，但这是为了我们所有人的利益。
entries.en: By regulating the borders of the member nations we can secure a safer and fairer galaxy for all. Though some might find the bureaucracy stifling, it is for the betterment of us all.

entries.zh: 星海共同体会积极行动起来，通过指令保障其成员国的主权，特别是那些主权和领土完整遭受其他帝国破坏的国家。
entries.en: The Galactic Community will put into motion directives to ensure the sovereignty of its members, particularly those who have previously had their integrity breached by other empires.

entries.zh: 这份提案会保证星海共同体的每一位成员对自己帝国的未来都能够发声。
entries.en: This resolution will that ensure every member of the Galactic Community will have a say about the future of their empire.

entries.zh: 尽管一个帝国要求其边境受到尊重是一件理所当然的事情，但星海共同体近期强制执行的指令变得有一些矫枉过正、过分迂腐了。为了确保官僚系统能够顺利运转，是时候废除其中的一些命令了。
entries.en: Though it is natural for empires to demand their borders be respected, the directives enforced by the Galactic Community have become overbearing and stifling. To ensure a smoothly functional bureaucracy, it is time to cut back on some of these mandates.

entries.zh: 作为我们精简星海官僚系统的努力，我们在参议院推行了一项更加先进的行政架构，专门面向那些相互之间已经有签署外交协议的成员国。
entries.en: As part of our efforts to simplify galactic bureaucracy, we are enforcing a clearer administrative hierarchy in the senate, particularly between those member states that already have diplomatic agreements in place.

entries.zh: 作为我们精简内政官僚系统的进一步深化改革，必须要赋予参议院中的强大成员国更大的权威。
entries.en: As part of our continual efforts to simplify its internal bureaucracy, even greater authority will be handed to the stronger members of the senate.

entries.zh: 尽管不得不承认，在这个过程中某一些国家的主权被强迫剥蚀，但我们消除官僚主义繁文缛节的努力极大地改善了参议院的工作效率！
entries.en: While some states have admittedly experienced a degradation of their sovereignty, our efforts to eliminate bureaucratic red tape have vastly improved the efficiency of the senate!

entries.zh: 我们专注于消除官僚上的繁文缛节，尽管取得了一定的成功，却导致数个成员国抱怨自己的国家主权遭到了侵蚀。他们现在正在提交一份议案，要求恢复部分已经失去的独立自主权利。
entries.en: Our focus on eliminating bureaucratic red tape, while successful, has caused several member states to complain that their sovereignty has been compromised. They are now proposing a mandate to restore some of that lost independence.

entries.zh: 受星海共同体的援助，这个帝国的宗主国对其附属国的内部事务有了更好的理解和更牢固的权威。
entries.en: Aided by the Galactic Community, this empire's overlord has greater insight and authority over the inner workings of their subjects.

entries.zh: 在星海共同体法律和政策的支持下，他们的力量增强了。
entries.en: They are strengthened by the support of the Galactic Community's laws and directives.

entries.zh: 有人说战争对生意来说不是好事，但对我们来说战争就是生意。我们的雇佣兵能在战火纷飞的星系中赚得盆满钵满，而我们正好也能和他们一起“共同富裕”。
entries.en: Some say war is bad for business, but war is our business. Our mercenaries thrive in an embattled galaxy, and through them, so will we.
